skill.summary: After an OpenClaw version change, read the CHANGELOG entry pinned to the installed version and surface user-relevant changes — new tools, breaking changes, o...

latestVersion.changelog: Detect plugin version drift between gateway and externalized npm plugins (catches the @openclaw/whatsapp-stayed-on-old-version failure mode). Verify channel health post-restart. Surface openclaw.json rewrites and stale plugin entries. Add attended vs unattended mode guidance. New helper: check-plugin-drift.sh.
